methodology: Separate direct Docker profiling with BusyBox time -v around latexmk, 500 synthetic pages. Same flags/image as worker; bypasses HTTP/Redis/polling and is NOT an API latency sample. User/system time and max resident size come from the timed process group/descendants per BusyBox time; not total Docker VM or deployment RAM. Emulation can distort CPU accounting.
